title: BloodPressureMeasurement
description: A schema representing a single blood pressure reading.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the measurement was taken.

systolic.description: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg (the top number).

diastolic.description: Diastolic blood pressure in mmHg (the bottom number).

pulse.description: Heart rate in beats per minute (optional).

bodyPosition.description: The position of the patient during measurement (optional).
